acceptance_criteria.text: Before runtime edits, record operator authority, the accepted WI084-based recovery boundary, exact ordinary/proposal/dashboard writer overlap, state and terminal outcomes, storage bounds, ownership rules, and explicit non-goals in WI085 and Decision 0080.

Implement bounded root-bound ordinary-v1 journals and shared per-working-root admission for typed create/edit/transition, proposals, and the overlapping dashboard writer. Provide stable-key replay/conflict semantics, read-only status, explicit conservative recovery, and clear CLI/API outcomes without changing proposal receipts or cleanup semantics.

Prove process-interruption behavior with child processes synchronized at each prepared/write/move/validation/receipt/rollback boundary; cover idempotent recovery, key replay/conflict, lock release/contention, root identity, corrupt or ambiguous state, external edits, links/escapes, capacity failure, and preservation of unrelated user data. Use available Windows and Linux environments and keep unsupported-platform coverage explicitly pending.

Complete exact-source focused regressions, one clean declared local CI profile, the separately required legacy Python comparator, frozen-surface validation, canonical validation, semantic identity and documentation reconciliation, generated dashboard, and truthful evidence with final commit/tree provenance; prepare one draft PR without hosted CI/CD, merge, or release.
